# telnyx_calendar_meetings (Data Source)

The meetings a calendar connection tracks in a time window (now to seven days ahead by default, at most 31 days), with whether the meeting bot will join each one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "telnyx_calendar_meetings" "next_week" {
  calendar_connection_id = telnyx_calendar_connection.team.calendar_connection_id
}

output "meetings_the_bot_joins" {
  value = [for m in data.telnyx_calendar_meetings.next_week.calendar_meetings : m.id if m.bot_will_join]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `calendar_connection_id` (String) The calendar connection id.

### Optional

- `from` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `to` (String)

### Read-Only

- `calendar_meetings` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--calendar_meetings))

<a id="nestedatt--calendar_meetings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `calendar_meetings`

Read-Only:

- `attendees` (Attributes List) Calendar attendees; identity fields are cleared after the retention window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--calendar_meetings--attendees))
- `bot_will_join` (Boolean) Effective policy decision, not proof that the bot has joined.
- `bot_will_join_override` (Boolean) Explicit override; null follows the connection policy.
- `decision` (String) Scheduling decision.
- `end_time` (String) Event end time.
- `id` (String) Tracked calendar meeting ID.
- `is_external_organizer` (Boolean) Whether the connected calendar user is not the organizer.
- `organizer` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--calendar_meetings--organizer))
- `platform` (String) Detected meeting platform.
- `session_id` (String) Linked meeting session ID, or null until one exists.
- `start_time` (String) Event start time.

<a id="nestedatt--calendar_meetings--attendees"></a>
### Nested Schema for `calendar_meetings.attendees`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `optional` (Boolean) Whether attendance is optional.
- `response_status` (String) Calendar RSVP status.
- `self` (Boolean) Whether this is the connected calendar user.


<a id="nestedatt--calendar_meetings--organizer"></a>
### Nested Schema for `calendar_meetings.organizer`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `self` (Boolean) Whether this is the connected calendar user.
